name: Arcos de la Frontera (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arcos de la Frontera (a three-arched bridge above waves on red).
history: Municipal flag of Arcos de la Frontera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Arcos de la Frontera arms — three arches above waves
